parameters.query:
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_delivery_mode' THEN value END) AS email_delivery_mode,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_test_recipient' THEN value END) AS email_test_recipient,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_sender_name' THEN value END) AS email_sender_name,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_reply_to' THEN value END) AS email_reply_to,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_signature_template_key' THEN value END) AS email_signature_template_key,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'n8n_base_url' THEN value END) AS n8n_base_url
FROM public.global_settings
WHERE key IN ('email_delivery_mode', 'email_test_recipient', 'email_sender_name', 'email_reply_to', 'email_signature_template_key', 'n8n_base_url');

const input = $('Resolve Preview Request').first()?.json ?? {};
const sqlLiteral = (value) => "'" + String(value ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
const replyToCaseEmailIdSql = input.reply_to_case_email_id ? sqlLiteral(input.reply_to_case_email_id) : 'NULL';
const sql = [
  'WITH selected_case AS (',
  '  SELECT * FROM public.cases WHERE id = ' + sqlLiteral(input.case_id) + '::uuid',
  '), parent_email AS (',
  '  SELECT',
  '    ce.id,',
  '    ce.case_id,',
  '    ce.direction,',
  '    ce.subject,',
  '    ce.body_html,',
  '    ce.body_text,',
  '    ce.recipients,',
  '    ce.internet_message_id,',
  '    ce.references_header,',
  '    ce.gmail_message_id,',
  '    ce.gmail_thread_id,',
  '    ce.sent_at,',
  '    ce.created_at',
  '  FROM public.case_emails ce',
  '  JOIN selected_case sc ON sc.id = ce.case_id',
  '  WHERE ce.id = ' + replyToCaseEmailIdSql + '::uuid',
  '  LIMIT 1',
  '), thread_messages AS (',
  '  SELECT json_agg(to_jsonb(thread_message) ORDER BY COALESCE(thread_message.sent_at, thread_message.created_at), thread_message.created_at) AS rows',
  '  FROM (',
  '    SELECT',
  '      ce.id,',
  '      ce.case_id,',
  '      ce.direction,',
  '      ce.subject,',
  '      ce.body_html,',
  '      ce.body_text,',
  '      ce.recipients,',
  '      ce.internet_message_id,',
  '      ce.in_reply_to_message_id,',
  '      ce.references_header,',
  '      ce.parent_case_email_id,',
  '      ce.gmail_thread_id,',
  '      ce.sent_at,',
  '      ce.created_at',
  '    FROM public.case_emails ce',
  '    JOIN selected_case sc ON sc.id = ce.case_id',
  "    WHERE ce.direction IN ('incoming', 'outgoing')",
  '  ) thread_message',
  '), message_template AS (',
  '  SELECT template_key, template_name, subject_template, text_template, html_template',
  '  FROM public.email_templates',
  '  WHERE template_key = ' + sqlLiteral(input.template_key) + ' AND template_type = 0 AND is_active = true',
  '  LIMIT 1',
  '), signature_templates AS (',
  '  SELECT',
  '    template_key,',
  "    COALESCE(NULLIF(template_name, ''), template_key) AS template_name,",
  '    text_template,',
  '    html_template',
  '  FROM public.email_templates',
  '  WHERE template_type = 2 AND is_active = true',
  "  ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(template_name, ''), template_key)",
  '), selected_signature AS (',
  '  SELECT *',
  '  FROM signature_templates',
  "  WHERE template_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(" + sqlLiteral(input.signature_template_key) + ", ''), (SELECT template_key FROM signature_templates LIMIT 1))",
  '  LIMIT 1',
  ')',
  'SELECT',
  "  COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(selected_case) FROM selected_case), '{}'::jsonb) AS case_row,",
  "  COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(parent_email) FROM parent_email), '{}'::jsonb) AS parent_email_row,",
  "  COALESCE((SELECT rows FROM thread_messages), '[]'::json) AS thread_message_rows,",
  '  (SELECT template_key FROM message_template) AS template_key,',
  "  (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(template_name, ''), template_key) FROM message_template) AS template_name,",
  '  (SELECT subject_template FROM message_template) AS subject_template,',
  '  (SELECT text_template FROM message_template) AS text_template,',
  '  (SELECT html_template FROM message_template) AS html_template,',
  '  (SELECT template_key FROM selected_signature) AS signature_template_key,',
  '  (SELECT template_name FROM selected_signature) AS signature_template_name,',
  '  (SELECT text_template FROM selected_signature) AS signature_text_template,',
  '  (SELECT html_template FROM selected_signature) AS signature_html_template,',
  "  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(to_jsonb(signature_templates)) FROM signature_templates), '[]'::json) AS signature_templates,",
  '  CASE',
  "    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_case) THEN 'Case not found.'",
  "    WHEN " + sqlLiteral(input.mode) + " IN ('reply', 'reply_all', 'forward') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parent_email) THEN 'Source email was not found for this case.'",
  "    WHEN " + sqlLiteral(input.template_key) + " <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_template) THEN 'Message template was not found.'",
  "    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_signature) THEN 'Signature template was not found.'",
  '    ELSE NULL',
  '  END AS error_message'
].join('\n');
return [{ json: { ...input, sql } }];
